content:
leo (AE): MercuryPay is kicking off a POC but wont start until we provide a bundle: SOC2 summary (they said full report ok behind NDA), ISO27001 cert copy, pen-test confirmation letter (signed), and staging IPs + ingress rules. They also asked whether Dedicated is mandatory for EU data residency and what delta that adds to monthly pricing. Any volunteers to assemble the package and produce a presigned upload so they can drop their environment diagrams?

anya (SE): I can assemble tech artifacts and prepare a cost comparison for Hosted vs Dedicated for EU residency. Quick check: do they need the SOC2 bridge letter or full attestation PDF? We usually require an NDA to share the full report.

leo (AE): They prefer the full attestation PDF under NDA. Also asked for contact to sign pen-test letter (CISO).

orchestrator-bot: New task created: TASK-8792 (evidence bundle for MercuryPay). Assignees: anya, dave.

anya (SE): For the presigned upload we can create a one-time POST form or a PUT presigned URL. I typically give a 48-72h PUT with SSE-S3 and block public ACL. Example I send customers:

```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_UPLOAD_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @network-diagram.png
```

anya (SE): Will need MercuryPays intended filename/path and their primary contact email to scope the dataroom folder. ETA: 4 business hours to provision link and a short upload doc.

dave (Security): We can provide ISO27001 certificate and SOC2 attestation under NDA. Pen-test: we provide a signed attestation letter with scope and testing date; raw findings are never published. If they insist on dedicated infra being in-scope for the pen-test, that triggers an infra pen-test addendum and extends review by 2-3 weeks. Also: redact any internal IPs from the network diagram if it maps to customer-facing infra.

leo (AE): Noted. They explicitly asked about the Dedicated cost bump for EU region; can you include a delta for 3-month POC vs annual commit?

anya (SE): Yes. I'll put together a short cost table (hosted token pricing, estimated burst capacity, Dedicated reserved monthly) and add notes about SLA differences and expected warmup time for Dedicated nodes.

leo (AE): Legal asked whether we can auto-sign a pen-test letter or we need a named signatory. They prefer the customer's CISO to have a signer to call out.

legal-bot: Standard pen-test attestation requires an authorized Security lead signature + company stamp. Template available at /legal/templates/pen-test-attest-v2. Attach NDA template if needed.

anya (SE): I'll create DR-5520 for MercuryPay and drop initial artifacts: SOC2 attestation summary, ISO cert, sample network diagram (sanitized). Dave, can you prepare the pen-test attestation PDF and call out scope wording: "hosted inference API endpoints, optional dedicated pool if customer reserves Dedicated"?

leo (AE): I'll confirm the CISO name and get them to sign the NDA. Also asked if we can provide ingress CIDRs for their firewall team now so they can pre-configure before we give staging IPs.

dave (Security): We can provide allowed CIDR ranges for staging (ephemeral). We need their staging VPC ID and expected egress range to validate. I'll provide a safe set: 10.11.200.0/24 and 10.11.201.0/24 as placeholders until they give real IDs.

anya (SE): Great — once they upload their diagram to DR-5520 I'll map their VPC and produce the ingress rule request for infra.

leo (AE): Thx team. I'll share the CISO contact and NDA timeline when I hear back. MercuryPay is eager to move fast so keeping this on a short loop. :rocket:
